AttackThwarted.description: Dawn's news that the Murderers attacked someone the Doctor had protected.
AttackThwarted.title: AttackThwarted

BallotCast.description: One Resident's ballot, revealed once every ballot of the Vote has been cast.
BallotCast.title: BallotCast

BidPlaced.description: How urgently one Resident wants to make the next Statement on the Open floor.
BidPlaced.title: BidPlaced

Control.description:
What the Host may do to a game being played: hold it before its next batch of
decisions, let one more batch through a held game, or let it run on.
Control.title: Control

ConversationMessagePosted.description: One message in a Conversation, heard only by the two Residents in it.
ConversationMessagePosted.title: ConversationMessagePosted

ConversationStarted.description: Two Residents slip away to talk. Everyone sees that they met, but not who asked whom.
ConversationStarted.title: ConversationStarted

Cost.description:
What some model calls used and cost together: the cost meter's numbers.

Prompt tokens are every token the model read, whether billed as plain input,
read from the cache or written to it.

cache_hit_rate.description: The share of prompt tokens read from the cache, or None before any prompt.

Cost.title: Cost

CostReport.description:
What a game's model calls cost: in all, for each Resident, and for the narrator,
who is not a Resident. The Residents' rows and the narrator's add up to the total.
CostReport.title: CostReport

DecisionFellBack.description: A decision source could not give a usable answer, so a safe default was used instead.
DecisionFellBack.title: DecisionFellBack

DecisionUnanswered.description:
The model gave no answer at all to a decision, so the game is aborted right after. No
Resident perceives it, so only full scope shows it: whose decision it was, and of what
kind, could reveal a Night role.
DecisionUnanswered.title: DecisionUnanswered

DenMessagePosted.description: One Murderer's message to the others, perhaps proposing tonight's Victim.
DenMessagePosted.title: DenMessagePosted

DuskIntentChosen.description: What a Resident means to do at Dusk: talk, wander or do a chore. Only they know.
DuskIntentChosen.title: DuskIntentChosen

Effort.description: How hard a Resident's Agent thinks before answering: more effort, slower and dearer.
Effort.title: Effort

Event.description: One entry in a game's log: a payload stamped with its place in the game.
Event.title: Event

Explanation.description:
The decision behind an event: every model attempt at it, and the fallback if one was used.

A decision made by a scripted bot has no attempts, because no model was asked.
Explanation.title: Explanation

FalseClaim.description: A Statement claiming a role that is not the speaker's.
FalseClaim.title: FalseClaim

GameAborted.description:
The game stopped before either side won: a decision got no answer, or the game itself
failed. `reason` is only the problem, such as a timeout, never the decision itself, so the
whole town may see the game stop.
GameAborted.title: GameAborted

GameConfig-Input.description: Everything the Host chooses before a game starts: its rules, its seed and who plays.

seed.description: Left out, the server draws one at random.

GameConfig-Input.title: GameConfigInput

GameConfig-Output.description: Everything the Host chooses before a game starts: its rules, its seed and who plays.
GameConfig-Output.title: GameConfig

GameConfigured.description:
Everything the Host chose, seed and lineup included. No Resident perceives it, so only
full scope shows it: casting follows from the seed, so knowing it would tell every role.
GameConfigured.title: GameConfigured

GameStarted.description: Who lives in the town, and the rules everyone plays by.
GameStarted.title: GameStarted

GameSummary.description:
A game at a glance. Its configuration is left out, since its seed would tell every role;
full scope reads it from the game's first event.
GameSummary.title: GameSummary

Influence.description:
How many of the others' ballots (`followed`) went against someone this Resident had
accused that Day, out of all the others' `ballots` on the Days they accused anyone before
a Vote. A vote to skip is a ballot that follows nobody.
Influence.title: Influence

KillVoteCast.description: One Murderer's choice of Victim; a lone Murderer's choice settles it.
KillVoteCast.title: KillVoteCast

LastWordsSpoken.description: What a banished Resident says before their role is revealed.
LastWordsSpoken.title: LastWordsSpoken

LieAbout.description:
A Statement accusing someone the speaker trusts, or defending someone they suspect,
beside what the speaker privately held about them.
LieAbout.title: LieAbout

Lineup-Input.description:
Who plays each Resident. A seat's own choice wins, then its side's, then everyone's;
the narrator follows everyone's.
Lineup-Input.title: LineupInput

Lineup-Output.description:
Who plays each Resident. A seat's own choice wins, then its side's, then everyone's;
the narrator follows everyone's.
Lineup-Output.title: Lineup

Memory.description: What a Resident carries in mind from one decision to the next.
Memory.title: Memory

Mind.description: One Resident's mind at one moment: who they are, what they remember, what they perceived.
Mind.title: Mind

OpenFloorTimedOut.description:
The Open floor's time limit ended it, before its Statement cap or two quiet Turns.

Recorded because it depends on the clock: a resumed game replays the record.
OpenFloorTimedOut.title: OpenFloorTimedOut

PlayedBy-Input.description:
Who plays a Resident: an Agent on a provider's model, or (`"scripted"`) a scripted bot.
The default is an Agent on Claude Haiku, on the Host's subscription unless an API key is set.
PlayedBy-Input.title: PlayedByInput

PlayedBy-Output.description:
Who plays a Resident: an Agent on a provider's model, or (`"scripted"`) a scripted bot.
The default is an Agent on Claude Haiku, on the Host's subscription unless an API key is set.
PlayedBy-Output.title: PlayedBy

RecapNarrated.description: The narrator's short recap of the Day so far, told at Dawn.
RecapNarrated.title: RecapNarrated

ReflectionWritten.description: A Resident's private journal entry, rewritten notebook and changed suspicions.
ReflectionWritten.title: ReflectionWritten

Resident.description: A character in the town. The seat fixes their house and their place in every ordering.
Resident.title: Resident

ResidentDied.description:
A death, announced to everyone with the dead Resident's role.

A Resident is banished by Vote, shot by the Sheriff or murdered at Night; a
Sheriff who shoots a Town Resident dies of the backfire.
ResidentDied.title: ResidentDied

ResidentInvestigated.description: What the Detective learns about one Resident. It is not always right.
ResidentInvestigated.title: ResidentInvestigated

ResidentProtected.description: The Doctor's protection for the Night. If the Murderers attack this Resident, they live.
ResidentProtected.title: ResidentProtected

RoleAssigned.description: A Resident learns their role and persona. Murderers also learn who their teammates are.
RoleAssigned.title: RoleAssigned

Rules.description: The rules of one game, which everyone in town knows.
Rules.title: Rules

SetupChoices.description:
What the setup form may offer: every provider, and every model with a price. A provider
with no API key here is refused when a game is started, saying which key it needs.
SetupChoices.title: SetupChoices

SheriffFired.description: The Sheriff spends the single bullet. Whoever is hit, and perhaps the Sheriff, dies next.
SheriffFired.title: SheriffFired

SheriffHeldFire.description:
The Sheriff chose not to fire this time and keeps the bullet.

It is recorded so every decision leaves a mark in the log. Only Spectators
perceive it: the town learns nothing, and the Sheriff already knows.
SheriffHeldFire.title: SheriffHeldFire

StatementMade.description: A Statement, with what it does: whom it names, accuses and defends, and any role claim.
StatementMade.title: StatementMade

Swing.description: One reflection (at `seq`) moving a Resident's suspicion of another a long way at once.
Swing.title: Swing

TurningEvent.description: A death or the Sheriff's shot: the event at `seq`.
TurningEvent.title: TurningEvent

VictimChosen.description: The Den's Victim: the most kill votes, with a tie drawn at random.
VictimChosen.title: VictimChosen

Visibility.description:
Who may perceive an event: everyone, a named set of Residents, or no Resident at all
(`spectators`). Public scope shows only what everyone perceives; full scope shows it all.
Visibility.title: Visibility
